producer_report.summary: I amended D152 in docs/decisions.md, and the decision now matches the widened scan. Decision (1) says the check scans BRIEF.md, README.md, every docs/*.md and the term's file sources. A dated note names the root cause: the checks covered the file's shape and its listed sources, not every governing source. The note says the docs/ scan is non-recursive. The Tradeoff now says docs/ subfolders are scanned only if a term lists them. I also fixed the two error messages in ontology.rs and the scan-scope sentence in the docs/ontology.toml header comment. Both ontology.rs messages now read 'not BRIEF.md, README.md, docs/*.md or one of the term's file sources'. `cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology` (30 tests) and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` (17 tests) pass. I did not run fmt, clippy or the full test suite.
